auckland-new-zealand-hobbiton-waikato-ea.slogan: A 210 km loop out of Hobbiton Waikato Easy Ride
auckland-new-zealand-hobbiton-waikato-ea.story: Scenery first, traffic last, with checkpoints that make sense on a bike. A 210 km loop that starts and ends near Titirangi, about 3 h 49 of riding. The stops in between: Rosebank, Scenic stretch near Parakai and near Rothesay Bay. near Titirangi is the high point. Long stretches are under trees.

auckland-new-zealand-hobbiton-waikato-ea.speedBand: 50–80 km/h riding core, local limits always win

sections.advice: Treat High point near Titirangi → Near Rosebank as bend craft. Brake early, look high through the turn, and keep throttle changes gentle. It is more satisfying to link ten clean bends than rescue one silly one.

Scenic stretch near Parakai → Photo stop near Rothesay Bay is the reward section in Auckland. Look through the bends, use legal pull-offs for photos and keep a little margin for tractors, cyclists and damp shade. The best ride here is smooth, not noisy.
Photo stop near Rothesay Bay → Tamaki is shade riding: beautiful, cooler and sometimes slick. Expect damp patches, leaves, gravel and wildlife where the trees meet the road.

safetyMarkers.note: Respect posted limits and assume enforcement near villages, viewpoints and main-road joins.
A line-crossing or merge area where relaxed sightseeing traffic can behave unpredictably.
Watch shade, leaves, gravel wash and damp patches; conditions decide the pace.
Viewpoints and car parks can create sudden stops in otherwise flowing terrain.

places-cueva-del-esquilo-maina.title: Cueva del Esquilo and maina

waypoints.name: Cueva del Esquilo
waypoints.advice: Cueva del Esquilo is where the day begins. Next is Cueva Ambrosio.

waypoints.name: Cueva Ambrosio
waypoints.advice: Cueva Ambrosio comes up 68 km in. Next is maina.

waypoints.name: maina
waypoints.advice: 136 km in you reach maina. Next is back through Cueva Ambrosio.

waypoints.name: back through Cueva Ambrosio
waypoints.advice: back through Cueva Ambrosio, late in the day. Next is Cueva del Esquilo.

waypoints.name: Cueva del Esquilo
waypoints.advice: Back at Cueva del Esquilo. That is the ride.

sections.advice: Cueva del Esquilo → Cueva Ambrosio is 56 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Cueva Ambrosio → maina is 69 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.
maina → back through Cueva Ambrosio is 69 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.
back through Cueva Ambrosio → Cueva del Esquilo is 56 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.

places-cueva-del-esquilo-maina.story: 271 km from Moratalla to Moratalla, about 4 h 40 of riding. The stops in between: Cueva Ambrosio, maina and back through Cueva Ambrosio. The highest point is about 1,200 m. The line favours views over speed.
